design_philosophy: Apple's design principles applied to B2B manufacturing. Minimal, premium, spacious, product-focused. Large confident typography, generous white space, strong hierarchy, alternating light/dark sections, macro imagery.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4. Emphasize negative letter-spacing for premium feel.

body.usage: Clean, highly readable body copy and UI elements.

layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use py-24 to py-32 for section padding. Substantial gaps (gap-8, gap-12).
layouts.bento_grid: Use an asymmetric 9-cell grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) for capabilities and feature summaries. Minimal borders, solid backgrounds, no heavy shadows.
layouts.hero: Center-aligned or heavy left-aligned massive typography, followed by a full-width macro video/image container with subtle parallax.
layouts.navigation: Translucent sticky nav. backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 (light) or bg-black/70 (dark). Must have prominent 'Request a Quote' CTA.
layouts.alternating_sections: Switch between #000000 and #FFFFFF backgrounds to create distinct chapters.

components.cards: Flat solid surfaces or bento cells. border-radius: 16px (rounded-2xl). border-border. Hover: slight transform (-translate-y-1) and subtle shadow increase.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary marketing CTAs. Standard rectangles (rounded-lg) for UI/Form elements.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI for RFQ form. Clean inputs, clear labels, minimal borders.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of client industries/materials. Slow, smooth drift. font-mono or uppercase minimal text.

motion.scrolling: MANDATORY: use @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It gives the site a premium weight.
motion.scroll_reveals: Use framer-motion for line-by-line text reveals in the hero, and staggered fade-up for bento grids.
motion.micro_interactions: Image scale-up on hover (overflow-hidden wrapper, hover:scale-105 on image).

image_urls.description: Textured metal object macro, dark and premium. Use for dark hero section.
Detailed close-up of shiny engine/metal components.
Close-up view of a detailed architectural blueprint. Use for 1983 heritage section.
Aerial view of modern industrial factory.
Macro shot of a drilling head showcasing precision engineering.

pages_structure.home: Hero with signature on-load reveal -> 'Engineering Since 1983' -> Marquee -> Bento Grid of Products -> Capabilities -> RFQ CTA.
pages_structure.products_catalog: Grid of specific categories: Vacuum Calibration Sleeves, Pistons, Cylinders, Custom Components.
pages_structure.product_detail: Spec tables, macro gallery, inline RFQ form.
pages_structure.about_history: Timeline starting from 1983, highlighting manufacturing experience.
pages_structure.rfq_contact: Form with file upload for drawings, embedded map, contact details.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. Use bento grids and asymmetric layouts.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and backdrop blurs (glass-morphism).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS. This disrupts reading flow.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary CTAs.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable (py-24, gap-8). Cramped designs look cheap.
Use @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth scrolling, framer-motion for reveals.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or dropdowns over content.
